Delicious cocktails!
Aug 2025 • Family
Hanoi’s cocktail scene is a vibrant fusion of tradition and innovation. Hidden speakeasies and rooftop bars serve creative drinks that blend local ingredients with international flair. From the zesty “Pho Cocktail,” inspired by Vietnam’s iconic soup, to tamarind-infused mojitos and lotus gin fusions, the city offers bold flavors in unforgettable settings. Sip under lantern lights in the Old Quarter or enjoy skyline views by West Lake. Talented mixologists craft each drink with care, reflecting Hanoi’s growing status as a cocktail destination. Whether you’re a curious traveler or a seasoned connoisseur, Hanoi’s cocktail culture promises something truly unique.
